craft_notes: Sthāyin: counterfactual gratitude (no word-nets without you-as-speakable). Device: end-dash→comma (rung stated softly, wrangling questioned). Rejected: 'brawled' for wrangled — killed: wrangle keeps wordy snares; brawl brings fists. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Had 'thee alone speaks all' ne'er rung, what sage
had wrangled, God, through wordy snares then?
l4.sanskrit_cite: vācya eṣāṃ tvam eveti nābhaviṣyad idaṃ yadi kaḥ kleśaṃ deva vāgjāleṣv akariṣyat sudhīs tadā

reads_against.argmap: If this 'you indeed are their expressible' had not been.; What wise one, O god, would then have taken trouble in word-nets? → Without you-as-expressible, no wise one would toil in words.
c1_essence: Subtle yet whole, gross yet unseen; word-nets toiled in vain without you-as-expressible.
reads_against.l2: Had it never been that 'you alone speak them all' — which sage, O god, would ever have strained through tangled words?
